scope: Defined-term errors only. Quotation style, section cross-references, meaning, and commercial points are not scored.

errors.text: “Earnback” has the meaning given in Clause 6.5.
errors.note: Earnback is defined in Clause 6.4(a); Clause 6.5 is Critical Service Level Failures.

errors.text: "Records" means all books, records, documents, data and information, in any form, relating to this Agreement, the Services and the Charges.
errors.note: Only glossary entry with straight quotes; conform to “Records”.

errors.text: “Work Product” means all reports, analyses, presentations and other written materials prepared by Supplier Personnel in the course of performing the Services.
errors.note: Never used; Clause 20 uses Developed Materials. Delete or use.

errors.text: "...from the Innovation Fund, and shall report the remaining balance of the Innovation Fund in each Monthly Performance Report."
errors.note: Defined only in Clause 12.1(d); no glossary pointer and no "(as defined in Clause 12.1(d))" at first use.

errors.error_type: Schedule-only term used in main body
errors.text: "...shall not exceed the At-Risk Amount."
errors.note: At-Risk Amount is defined only for Schedule B; no glossary pointer; Clause 1.4 confines it to Schedule B.

errors.text: "Where Supplier has incurred a Service-Level Credit in respect of a Critical Service Level..."
errors.note: Defined term is “Service Level Credit” (no hyphen).

errors.text: "Where a payment is made under a Local Service Agreement, ..."
errors.note: Defined term is “Local Services Agreement”.

errors.text: "...Supplier shall deliver to Customer a Remediation Plan within ten (10) Business Days..."
errors.note: Undefined; the Agreement uses “Corrective Action Plan”.

errors.error_type: Schedule-only term used in main body
errors.text: "...restore each affected Service within the applicable RTO..."
errors.note: RTO is defined only in Schedule I; no pointer or attribution (contrast Schedule J ¶4.2).

errors.text: "...other than in accordance with the change control procedure;"
errors.note: Should be “Change Control Procedure”.

errors.text: "any Bank Regulator requires or requests Customer to take action..."
errors.note: Undefined; glossary defines “Regulator”.

errors.text: "For the purposes of this Clause 27.5, a “Change of Control” occurs where any person ... acquires beneficial ownership of thirty percent (30%) or more of the voting securities of Supplier..."
errors.note: Clause 1.1 uses a more-than-50% / substantially-all-assets test.

errors.text: "...Supplier shall meet the service levels applicable to each affected In-Scope Application..."
errors.note: Should be “Service Levels”.

errors.text: "Supplier shall cooperate with the Service Integrator and with each Managed Third Party..."
errors.note: Dropped from scoring after the key was drafted. "Service Integrator" is not defined in the final text, so a reviewer who flags it is correct, but the item counts for no one.

errors.text: “Service Level Credit” means ... the Pool Allocation Percentage for the affected Critical Service Level multiplied by the At-Risk Amount, calculated solely by reference to the Monthly Charges for the Service Tower to which the failed Critical Service Level relates.
errors.note: Clause 1.1 bases the credit on total Monthly Charges for all Service Towers.

errors.text: “Minimum Service Level” means, in respect of a Service Level, the minimum level of performance specified for that Service Level in Schedule B, failure to achieve which constitutes a Service Level Failure.
errors.note: Word-for-word repeat of Clause 1.1.

errors.text: “Business Day” means a day other than a Saturday, a Sunday or a day that is a public holiday in New York, New York or in Bengaluru, India.
errors.note: Clause 1.1 uses New York and London bank closing days; affects Schedule C ¶5 and ¶9 dates.

errors.text: “Benchmark Adjustment” has the meaning given in Clause 14.1.
errors.note: Defined inline in Clause 14.2(a); 14.1 defines Benchmark Review.

errors.text: “Parallel Run” means a period during which the incumbent arrangements of the Customer Group and the arrangements of Supplier are operated simultaneously...
errors.note: Never used.

errors.text: "If any critical deliverable is not accepted by its Milestone Date, ..."
errors.note: Should be “Critical Deliverable”.

errors.text: “Tower Review Board” means the board of senior representatives of the Parties convened annually to review the strategic direction of each Service Tower.
errors.note: No such body in the governance structure or Escalation Levels.

errors.text: "The Joint Operations Committee shall meet at least monthly, ..."
errors.note: Defined term is “Joint Operating Committee” / “JOC”.

errors.text: "Supplier shall not remove or reassign any Key Personel during the Minimum Tenure Period..."
errors.note: Should be “Key Personnel”.

errors.text: “Security Incident” means any actual or reasonably suspected (a) unauthorised access to, or acquisition, use, disclosure, modification, loss or destruction of, Customer Data, or (b) compromise of ... any System used to Process Customer Data.
errors.note: Word-for-word repeat of Clause 1.1.

errors.text: "...within one (1) hour after becoming aware of any security incident affecting Customer Systems, ..."
errors.note: Should be “Security Incident”.

errors.text: "...appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect customer data against unauthorised or unlawful Processing..."
errors.note: Should be “Customer Data”.

errors.text: "Supplier shall maintain a Disaster Recovery Site located not less than two hundred and fifty (250) miles from the primary Data Centre, ..."
errors.note: Only Disaster, Disaster Recovery Plan and Disaster Recovery Services are defined.

errors.text: “Termination Assistance Period” has the meaning given in Clause 27.2.
errors.note: Clause 27.2 is Termination Charges; the period is in Clause 28.1 (glossary correctly says so).

errors.text: "Supplier shall update the Exit Plann within thirty (30) days after the end of each Contract Year..."
errors.note: Should be “Exit Plan”.

errors.text: "Emergency Change" means a Change that must be implemented urgently to prevent or resolve a Severity Level 1 Incident, a Security Incident or a breach of Applicable Law.
errors.note: All other definitions use curly quotes.

errors.text: “Representative Sample” means a sample of not fewer than three (3) comparable transactions drawn from the Comparison Group.
errors.note: Never used; benchmarking uses the Comparison Group.

tricky_but_correct.item: Plurals/possessives: Service Level Credits, Statements of Work, Local Services Agreements, Critical Deliverables, Supplier’s, Customer Group’s
SOW / Statement of Work; ESC; JOC; LSA; KPI; ARC; RRC; Tax / Taxes
Critical Service Level Failure / Critical Service Level / Minimum Service Level / Measurement Periods in one sentence

tricky_but_correct.location: Clause 4.5(a) (and all Part 2C pairs except E1)
tricky_but_correct.item: “Delay Payment” pointer → Clause 4.5, inline definition there
"Critical Business Function (as defined in Schedule I) ... Recovery Time Objective (as defined in Schedule I)"
tricky_but_correct.why_correct: Cross-Schedule use with explicit attribution (contrast E9).

tricky_but_correct.item: "Minimum Tenure Period (as defined in Schedule F)"
tricky_but_correct.why_correct: Schedule term used in main body with attribution, permitted by Clause 1.4 (contrast E5).

tricky_but_correct.item: Pool Allocation Percentage (also Severity Level, Resource Unit, Baseline Volume, Base Charges, ARC, RRC, KPI, Benchmarker, Standard Contractual Clauses)
tricky_but_correct.why_correct: Schedule-defined but with a correct Clause 1.1 pointer.
Quoted words, not definitions; statutory quotation.

tricky_but_correct.item: ALL-CAPS disclaimer and jury waiver containing SERVICES, DELIVERABLES, DISPUTE
tricky_but_correct.why_correct: Conspicuousness requirement; defined terms still correct.

tricky_but_correct.item: Termination Assistance Services vs Termination Assistance Period vs Termination Date vs Termination Notice; Supplier Materials vs Supplier Proprietary Software; Customer Facilities vs Supplier Facilities
tricky_but_correct.why_correct: Distinct defined terms used in their own senses.

tricky_but_correct.item: "Benchmark Adjustment (as defined in Clause 14.2)"; "Innovation Fund (as defined in Clause 12.1(d))"
tricky_but_correct.why_correct: Inline-only terms used elsewhere with explicit cross-reference (contrast E4).
